legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 513 Appearance by registered valuer in certain matters.

legal_units.title: Appearance by registered valuer in certain matters.
legal_units.text: Any assessee, entitled or required to attend before any income-tax authority or the Appellate Tribunal in matters relating to the valuation of any asset, may attend through a registered valuer.
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 513 Appearance by registered valuer in certain matters. Section 513(1): Any assessee, entitled or required to attend before any income-tax authority or the Appellate Tribunal in matters relating to the valuation of any asset, may attend through a registered valuer.

legal_units.title: Appearance by registered valuer in certain matters.
legal_units.text: The provisions of sub-section (1) shall not apply, where the assessee is required to attend personally for examination on oath or affirmation under section 246.
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 513 Appearance by registered valuer in certain matters. Section 513(2): The provisions of sub-section (1) shall not apply, where the assessee is required to attend personally for examination on oath or affirmation under section 246.

legal_units.title: Appearance by registered valuer in certain matters.
legal_units.text: For the purposes of this section, the expression "registered valuer" means a person registered as a valuer under section 514.
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 513 Appearance by registered valuer in certain matters. Section 513(3): For the purposes of this section, the expression "registered valuer" means a person registered as a valuer under section 514.
